# Getting Help with Hmunmawi

Thanks for using Hmunmawi. Before opening an issue, please use the place that best fits what you need:

- **Setup questions & troubleshooting:** read [The Hmunmawi guide](../docs/GUIDE.md) or ask in [Q&A & Setup Help](https://github.com/priyevsingh/hmunmawi/discussions/categories/q-a-setup-help).
- **Feature ideas & new integrations:** propose and discuss ideas in [Ideas & Feature Requests](https://github.com/priyevsingh/hmunmawi/discussions/categories/ideas-feature-requests).
- **Custom add-ons, scripts & `hm` / MCP workflows:** share and get help in [Add-ons, Scripts & MCP](https://github.com/priyevsingh/hmunmawi/discussions/categories/add-ons-scripts-mcp).
- **Share your shipped app:** showcase your app alongside [Wall of Apps](../docs/WALL-OF-APPS.md) in [Wall of Apps / Show & Tell](https://github.com/priyevsingh/hmunmawi/discussions/categories/wall-of-apps-show-tell).
- **Bug reports:** open a [Bug report](../../issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) with steps to reproduce, macOS version, and app version.
- **Security vulnerabilities:** report privately on the **Security** tab ([Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/priyevsingh/hmunmawi/security/advisories/new)) as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Never open a public issue or post API keys/secrets anywhere.
